{{Quote|Bad Wicket! Mama said never to play in poison ivy!|Winda Warrick|<ref name="WGF" />}}
'''Poison ivy''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] in [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] and caused an itchy rash. When the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] was going [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] with his younger [[Gender/Legends|sister]], [[Winda Warrick|Winda]], the little [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] dropped her [[Fishing pole|rod]] next to a poison ivy bush. Wicket chased after rod and went through the ivy to get it, but Winda then giggled, pointing out that it was poison ivy, which caused him to itch. After the Ewoks got home, their [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shodu Warrick|Shodu]], told Wicket to go get a cure for the rash from [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], the [[Shaman/Legends|medicine man]]. Logray provided a potion that cured Wicket's itch and sent him into a deep [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]].<ref name="WGF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Poison ivy appeared in ''[[Wicket Goes Fishing: An Ewok Adventure]]'', a [[1986]] picture book written by [[Melinda Luke]] and illustrated by [[A. O. Williams]].<ref name="WGF" />
